edges.schema: approved RTB taxonomy + Search Planner handoff; immutable publication/project
edges.identity: project_id TEXT; taxonomy_version_id BIGINT; publication ID/version pinned
edges.evidence: approved publication, approved taxonomy, query validation; source permission before any provider call
edges.oracle: nonapproved taxonomy cannot create a trusted query/collector assignment
edges.risk: cross-branch source file names may differ

edges.schema: SP durable task plan -> Collector approved intake
edges.identity: project_id TEXT, query/task IDs, source_id TEXT, quota/policy/receipt IDs
edges.evidence: validated query, provider capability, budget ledger, idempotent task receipt
edges.oracle: same approved task replay gives one accepted inbox; denied source leaves no collector paid action

edges.schema: collector durable SRE intake / canonical video and content origin
edges.identity: videos.id BIGINT, project_registry.id TEXT, sre_live_runs.run_id UUID, sre_live_items.id BIGINT
edges.evidence: source video and content SHA, project membership, source policy, text/media rights
edges.oracle: forged/expired collector ACK rejected; valid D1 origin accepted once with same source video

edges.identity: sre_live_runs.run_id UUID; verified_pair_results.result_id UUID; human_reviews.review_id UUID; item.id BIGINT; qdp_runs.sre_live_run_id UUID; video BIGINT
edges.evidence: event SHA-256, M30 receipt, latest M32 revision, M36 outbox ACK, source origin and revocation intent/tombstone
edges.oracle: real reviewed LIVE event -> exactly one durable QDP receipt; invalidated replay never resurrects Qualified Set

edges.identity: qdp_runs.id UUID; video BIGINT; ga_runs.id UUID; ga_results.id BIGINT
edges.evidence: approved media roots, media asset SHA, source.can_analyze_media, current-rights view; compensation first
edges.oracle: real preparation delivers once; revocation suppresses current prepared media; inbox != analysis complete

edges.identity: qdp_run UUID; group_b_run UUID; group_b_result BIGINT; video BIGINT
edges.evidence: QDP current preparation, qdp_input_sha256, project/source/source_policy version
edges.oracle: without current B preparation no receipt; replay same SHA one accepted run

edges.schema: QDP C preparation -> Group C accepted inbox / metric run
edges.identity: qdp_run UUID; group_c_runs.id UUID; calculated_metrics.id BIGINT; video BIGINT
edges.evidence: current C preparation, scope, source policy, metric observation times/cohort config
edges.oracle: wrong QDP run/source policy or stale metric cannot produce certified C result

edges.schema: GA outbox -> GB exact snapshot binding
edges.identity: ga_runs.id UUID; ga_results.id BIGINT; group_b_runs.id UUID; qdp_run UUID
edges.evidence: completed GA result SHA, pinned media identity and Group B exact source
edges.oracle: B never consumes uncommitted GA snapshot; durable replay idempotent

edges.identity: same project/video/source/qdp_run/policy; B/C runs UUID; analysis/metric BIGINT
edges.evidence: both run completed and inbox accepted; evidence hashes pinned separately
edges.oracle: cross-project or mismatched source/version never creates joint receipt

edges.schema: Group C outbox -> UAE transactional metric reception
edges.identity: group_c_runs.id UUID; group_c_outbox.id UUID; uae_group_c_receptions.id BIGINT
edges.evidence: same DB transaction, cohort config, current source permissions, committed receipt != qualification
edges.oracle: no complete C measurement -> no UAE qualified snapshot; exact one receipt on replay

edges.identity: project TEXT, video BIGINT, sre LIVE UUID, qdp_run UUID, A/B/C result IDs, evidence SHA
edges.evidence: original M30+M32, current QDP+GA/GB/C rights; as_of; tenant isolation
edges.oracle: valid real seven-port input can qualify only through independently authorized mechanism; current guard refuses all forged positive writes

edges.schema: signed UAE qualified dataset/manifest; PIE independent provenance authority
edges.identity: UAE snapshot BIGINT; PIE research/dataset UUID; project TEXT; source_policy_version BIGINT
edges.evidence: signed one-use nonce, qualified current rights, row-level provenance & source license
edges.oracle: signed-but-unapproved input remains NOT ready_for_analysis; authenticated authorized current dataset only
